rig.parents_from: paired original mesh glTF; PSA BONENAMES ParentIndex placeholder is not hierarchy
rig.missing_tracks_status: 仅保留原始PSA数据，不加入新骨骼。6clips的config标RemoveTracks=all；Stun未标，但两者仍不属于原35骨mesh。

coordinate_rules.reason: PSA key mirror is undone; UModel animation nonroot FixRotationKeys differs from unmodified BONENAMES refpose; glTF conjugates root and swaps Y/Z. Java applies proper 180-degree Y rotation.
coordinate_rules.psa_time: VQuatAnimKey.Time is 1 frame-unit for every key; seconds=f/AnimRate, not the stored Time=1 seconds.
coordinate_rules.psa_parent: Exporter placeholder, never used. 35 real bone parents resolved from same original mesh glTF; 2 unused tracks remain raw data only.

retarget.reference: source PSA USkeleton refpose; target body input bind. Frozen JSON also retains exported glTF bind and differences.
retarget.initial_pose: 零动作参考输入严格回到目标bind；动画第0帧通常是原站姿，不能强制当bind。进入动画是否混合属于明确适配。
retarget.marker_translation: 六个网格marker在所有原动作里局部位置范围都是0；PSA参考误差最高约5e-6 px。保持目标偏移，源数值微差可保留。
retarget.full_SE3_world_delta_warning: 完整SE3对不同marker原点引入杠杆位移；当前7clip中与保留target offsets方法差异最大约0.00897239px，Walk/Stun右臂有轻微量化旋转时出现。
retarget.do_not_freeze_joint_translations: J_* 动作含真实局部位移，尤其手部；仅复制旋转会破坏原姿态。
retarget.final_native_serialization: 解出最终local quaternion后转原生Euler顺序，连续解包，再减native rest Euler；此减法只是输出适配，不能替代旋转重定向。
retarget.reference_frame_api: reference_frame(data, original_clip_name, source_seconds) -> source_local/world and target_local/world matrices; source sampled with linear position+slerp rotation, clamp at last sample.

七段原动作与GIF播放总长不同；按姿态/原秒数核对，不能宣称相同GIF帧号就是相同秒数。
